title: Sprite (sprites/<name>.json)
description: Animations with PNG sheet pages each, palettes for indexed pixels (assets.md, 'Sprites'). Tier L1; sheets and palettes are L2.

tone_group.description: Palette toning group (palette_modifiers.json); 0 or absent: none.

palettes.description: RGB PNG, one row per palette variant, relative to the sprite JSON.

scale.description: Texture pixels per logical unit (HD sheets); default 1.

depth_extents.description: Buildings: per direction (0..3), the extent in pixels over which a construction preview spreads the footprint's depth difference.

autotile.description: Path tilesets: frame per neighbor mask (bits 0..7 = N, NE, E, SE, S, SW, W, NW), -1 for none.

oneOf.description: True-color sprites have no palettes, so no palette variants and no toning.

plane.description: Building planes; absent for plain animations.

sheets.description: Pages of the unique frames, left to right and top down, `columns` x `rows` frames per page; relative to the sprite JSON.

rows.description: Frame rows per page; absent: one page holds every row.

frame_map.description: Unique frame of each direction * frames + frame; omitted when it is the identity.

run_length.description: Pixels after which the frames' long runs are split when the engine run-length encodes them; omitted for 127.
